description: APIS is an open-source system for coordinating electricity exchange among connected batteries. Its repository assembles a control engine, web dashboard, network services and an emulator that represents DC/DC converters and battery behaviour when hardware is absent. Inputs are battery conditions, exchange preferences, price or availability settings and device configuration; outputs include controlled exchanges, transaction logs and operating metrics. Geographic coverage follows the deployed set of homes or facilities, and time resolution depends on the controller setup. Apache-2.0 source and Docker or host installation guides are public. A limitation is that the full installation comprises several component repositories and real-device use needs compatible converters and drivers; the emulator alone does not prove physical reliability or safety. APIS can support distributed electricity-storage and peer-to-peer energy studies. It is related to microgrid simulation platforms but includes an operational control stack. The public README was reviewed; no controller, hardware connection or energy trade was started.
name: APIS autonomous battery exchange platform
